# RoboTwin 2.0 evaluation environment

This directory contains the RoboTwin simulator tasks, task descriptions and
configuration used for ReRead rollouts. The worker loads the task, robot and
camera configuration and obtains instructions from the task templates.

Upstream: https://github.com/RoboTwin-Platform/RoboTwin at revision
`bf44be51cf5717a5595ce59447f2cf5263d2aa95`. The upstream MIT
[license](LICENSE) applies. See [the reproduction guide](../../docs/reproduce.md)
for the simulator assets, dependencies and rollout command.
